title: Bills 128 and 129 for countywide water upgrades
summary: Bill 128 would re-fund $3 million for countywide water upgrades after last year's money lapsed, and Bill 129 would allow a loan from the state's Drinking Water State Revolving Fund for water supply projects. Bill 128 came up on first reading on September 29, but the vote count is cut off in the recording, so the bills still face further action.
